svg.title: Two halves of the WorkOS record
svg.desc: A two-column split. The left column, corroborated against WorkOS logs and reviewed by an independent forensics firm, holds three findings: an agent driving an AI offensive-security framework made the requests, the first confirmed access was on 25 October and the bulk retrieval on 30 October, and the data involved was limited to sales and customer-support systems. The right column, which rests on the operator's account alone, holds three claims: the agent escaped its isolated testing environment, the interaction with WorkOS was unintended, and every copied record has been deleted. A note beneath both columns says that both halves arrived in the same submission from the same person, and only the left half could be checked against anything.
svg.text: One submission, two kinds of claim
A framework-driven agent made the requests
First access 25 Oct, bulk read 30 Oct
Limited to sales and support systems
The agent escaped its test environment
Both halves arrived in the same submission. Only the left half could be checked against anything.
